name: ESLint Static Analysis (files parse, React hook rules)
note: ESLint prints one line per finding and nothing when clean, so there is no sentence that means "passed". It also has no case structure, which is the only reason judging by exit code is safe here — see isGreen() in the runner. oxlint until 2026-10-01; replaced because Smart App Control blocks its unsigned native binary on some days (SudokuDiary 85).

mutations.name: source that does not parse
mutations.why: A build can still succeed from a stale bundle while the source in the tree is broken. The linter is the first thing that should notice.

mutations.name: a hook called conditionally
mutations.why: It builds, and at runtime React pairs this hook with another one's state; the replay screen shows the wrong record or throws. Nothing else reads for this.

mutations.name: a setter that no longer exists is still called
mutations.why: Added with no-undef 2026-10-07 (BACKLOG D6). The real case: the home level chips called a removed setLockedToast on every tap (Diary 91). Vite bundles it silently and it throws only when the line runs.
